stations.title: Idris
stations.say: Why is the report still running?

stations.title: Sefton
stations.text: Wants to rewrite the whole report.

stations.title: Hesper
stations.say: Now we know where to start.

captions: At Ashgrove Press, Idris finds the night's report still running in the morning.
Sefton wants to rewrite it all, but nobody knows which part is slow.
You write tools that time each step fairly and count the work it does.
Now the report's steps are timed and counted, and the slow one is plain to see.
Same report, same answers, and a plan that starts where the time goes.
